modmenu.descriptionTranslation.xperience: A Vanilla+ Minecraft mod focused on experience, enchanting, and related quality-of-life improvements.
xperience-xpanded.config.constantXpPerLe: Replaces the vanilla experience curve with a constant amount of XP required to advance each level.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpRequiredPerLe: The amount of XP required to gain each level when the constant XP curve is enabled.
xperience-xpanded.config.retainXpOnDeath: Allows players to retain some or all of their experience after dying.
xperience-xpanded.config.retainedXpPerce: The percentage of total experience retained after death, from 10% to 100%.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpFromBreakingM: Grants experience when breaking fully grown crops, including Nether Wart.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpPerMatureCrop: The amount of experience awarded for breaking a fully grown crop.
xperience-xpanded.config.shearingGrantsX: Grants experience when successfully shearing an adult sheep.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpPerShearedShe: The amount of experience awarded for shearing a sheep.
xperience-xpanded.config.allowXpBottleBr: Allows Bottles o' Enchanting to be obtained through brewing.
xperience-xpanded.config.useFixedXpBottl: Makes Bottles o' Enchanting grant a fixed amount of experience instead of a random amount.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpPerExperience: The amount of experience awarded by each Bottle o' Enchanting when fixed rewards are enabled.
xperience-xpanded.config.removeAnvilTooE: Removes the maximum level cost restriction that normally prevents expensive anvil operations.
xperience-xpanded.config.removeAnvilPrio: Prevents previous anvil operations from increasing the experience cost of subsequent operations.
xperience-xpanded.config.grindstoneXpMul: Multiplies the experience recovered when removing enchantments with a Grindstone. Rewards are no longer randomized.
xperience-xpanded.config.allowGrindstone: Allows Grindstones to remove curse enchantments from items.
xperience-xpanded.config.grindstoneCurse: Additional XP multiplier applied when removing curses. A value of 0.5 reduces the total reward by 50%.
xperience-xpanded.config.fortuneBoostsXp: Increases XP from mining and harvesting by 20% per Fortune level.
xperience-xpanded.config.lootingBoostsXp: Increases experience dropped by mobs by 20% per Looting level.
xperience-xpanded.config.luckOfTheSeaBoo: Luck of the Sea XP Bonus
Increases experience earned from fishing by 20% per Luck of the Sea level.
xperience-xpanded.config.mendingPrefersH: Prioritizes repairing the Mending-equipped item with the highest percentage of missing durability.
xperience-xpanded.config.xpOrbAttraction: The maximum distance, in blocks, at which experience orbs are attracted to players.
xperience-xpanded.config.enableEchoShard: Enables a crafting recipe for Echo Shards, making them renewable.
xperience-xpanded.config.allowSilkTouchB: Allows Budding Amethyst blocks to be collected using a tool enchanted with Silk Touch.
xperience-xpanded.config.replaceClericXp: Replaces the master-level Cleric's Bottle o' Enchanting trade with an Echo Shard trade.
effect.xperience-xpanded.wisdom.descript: You can feel your brain expanding
